requirements.text: Preserve list/card/pipeline views, search of display name/email/phone, closed status/source filters and all-selected-tags AND semantics in navigable URL state. Hide retired contacts from active directory. Bound requests 1–100 with 24 row default UI pages; changing filter/search/view resets cursor while preserving sibling filters. Use deterministic createdAt +ID keyset and tenant-scoped validated cursors; invalid/foreign cursor cannot disclose rows. Treat search metacharacters literally. Inactive badges use current church-local threshold and effective confirmed-contact date, not email opens or administrative tasks. Full basic contact/address fields remain operationally available only under current tenant DTO policy.

Preserve contact, independent address/source/sourceDetails/summary notes and stage fields with server validation after trim. Normal full form names allow bounded 255 character components; reject wholly blank display identity. A minimum named guest may supply one real display name with optional phone/email and no fabricated surname. Quick defaults are prospect, source other (meeting quick-add uses meeting_guest_list), and optional US country default shown/edit able. Explicit null clears nullable fields rather than blank→undefined losing the edit. Account link/storage key/creator/revision are server-owned. Create/edit writes actor/version/history/audit atomically and do not imply account, adult, commitment, consent or safety clearance. Background-check fields are excluded from every current form/DTO/import/export/tool.

Use attributable soft retirement, preserving authorized CRM relations/history and private file references; remove from active queries/selectors and prevent new current references. Review actionable assigned duties and household/leadership/assignment effects before committing; unresolved work remains explicitly Needs owner rather than disappears. Native/reviewed restore rechecks tenant/revision, restores only an ordinary retired Person and recomputes current eligibility; it does not restore account seats or transfer private care. Merged sources are denied ordinary restore and routed to reviewed Unmerge. Retired history remains discoverable under current permission.

Maintain one live same plant Person per account through a partial uniqueness arbiter. Owner bootstrap and accepted ordinary seat link reuse an exact already-linked identity; otherwise show/select a same-email active unlinked contact only when verified non ambiguous, or create a new linked Person. Never choose the oldest ambiguous email match as identity proof or steal another link; client cannot set accountId. Seat removal/email change retains stable account-link history and independently edit able CRM email. Recruited-contact source composition remains distinct from all-currently-committed adult size: bootstrap alone is no recruitment/commitment evidence, while a login holder with real adult active commitment may count.

Apply 3 MiB verified JPG/JPEG/PNG/WebP private image policy and same plant live Person authority. Save generated key/reference/version atomically before old unreferenced cleanup; return authenticated Person/version image route without raw key or signed bearer URL. Foreign/retired photo access returns unavailable. Merge may choose only stored source/survivor photo and keeps referenced bytes until manifest/inverse retention no longer needs them. Failure cleanup cannot delete another currently referenced blob; failed write keeps old reference.

Allow all 7 closed stages, deliberate forward skips and backward moves with shown skipped-stage guidance, actor/date/reason and expected revision. Same-stage is a no-op receipt. Use one change-stage command from profile and pipeline so profile edit cannot bypass warnings. Leaving committed statuses core_group/launch_team/leader offers exact open-duty handoff to current eligible owner or explicit decline/Needs owner; no hidden partial loop. Stage change alone never withdraws commitment, changes adult classification or revokes earned training/seat. Recording interview/commitment or correction never incidentally demotes an advanced stage.

Preserve five visible pipeline columns with final core-group column also containing launch_team/leader milestone badges. Reorder only current active same plant IDs under column/version lock; empty request no-op and foreign/stale order refuses rather than changes unrelated contacts. Read-only viewers have no drag mutation. Cards display only active parent follow-up work and due-local-day overdue/missing warnings. Complete/no_longer_needed/deleted obligations do not show open urgency; a contact without any explicitly created duty may be uncovered but is not invented urgent work. Page/bound queries without dropping full filtered result semantics.

Typed activity timeline uses event Instant+ID cursor, preserving tied timestamps and visible performer/provenance. Notes validate nonblank bounded 5000 characters; author alone edits/deletes their own note under exact Person/kind/tenant/revision. Edit preserves original occurrence and actor, appends old/new/current author/editedAt/reason correction; delete removes current note body with attributable tombstone/history subject to shared-record deletion policy. Summary profile notes remain separate fields. System audit/qualification events are not user-edit able notes. Meeting-linked note must validate actual meeting/attendance relation server-side.

Tenant household name/address and head/spouse/child/other membership roles are operational facts, not adult classification. Create household+initial head coherently; join validates live same plant Person/household and copies household address only if Person lacks meaningful address. Leaving preserves Person address. Address propagation previews exact active members/current revisions and deliberately overwrites them in one bounded transaction, returning actual count. Empty-household deletion refuses active members; retired member references detach from current household while immutable old membership snapshots retain provenance. Lock Person/household consistently against retire/join/delete to avoid orphan records.

Keep church-defined labels with trimmed name 1–100, optional supported named/hex color, explicit nullable clear and unique current tenant normalized name. Assignment validates live Person+tag same tenant and unique pair. Retry assign/remove writes one semantic activity or original no-op receipt, never fictitious tag event. Rename updates views/export; deletion previews linked count, removes current links and preserves attributable audit without becoming global taxonomy.

Preserve categories worship/tech/admin/teaching/hospitality/leadership/other, optional proficiency beginner/intermediate/advanced/expert, trimmed skill name 1–100 and bounded 5000 character notes. Add/edit/remove have expected revision and atomic activity/correction; category grouping and null clear roundtrip. Retire removed current item while preserving owned history. Recorded skill search/organization is allowed; it does not replace human Gifted interview criterion or infer calling/readiness.

Record dated human Committed/Compelled/Contagious/Courageous assessment, each integer 1–5 and optional bounded 5000 character lens notes. Compute total 4–20 server-side and enforce score/total integrity. Preserve all records, actor/occurrence date/recorded instant and latest ordering by assessment LocalDate, recordedAt, ID; late historical entry cannot become latest merely by recording time. Advisory early-stage warning is not a hard gate. Recording does not change stage. Correction is REQ-PPL-015 and never supplies model person judgment.

Keep all five criteria Maturity/Gifted/Chemistry/Right Reasons/Season as pass/fail/concern with dated human notes, next steps and result qualified/qualified_with_notes/not_qualified/follow_up. ANY result means interview occurred; on lower earlier stage record interviewed progression atomically, while an already core_group/launch_team/leader remains advanced. Only explicit stage command demotes. Chronological latest and attributable history match assessments. Next steps remain recorded text; intended-but-undelivered automatic task prompts are not registered as automation. A user can explicitly draft/create named task through ordinary Task command.

Preserve core_group/launch_team commitment types, actual signed LocalDate, optional witness/notes/private PDF/JPG/PNG≤10 MiB and authenticated document download. Witness is an optional same plant Person selected from valid tenant record; unstructured external witness may be dated text without foreign Person FK. Support 10 MiB through bounded authenticated upload reference flow rather than oversize action body; failure tracks orphan bytes and never links arbitrary keys. Record/signature, person level active commitment projection, history/source revision/audit and lower-stage core_group entry commit together. Advanced stage is not demoted by repeat card. Explicit dated withdrawal/reactivation changes person lifecycle not stage; old signature cannot override withdrawal. Apply REQ-PPL-026 for current adult size/genuine history.

Correct exact same plant Person/record kind under current Owner/Admin and expected record revision. Reuse original domain validations; recompute assessment total, preserve original recording actor/time and append typed old/new/corrector/time/reason/receipt before commit. Ordinary score/result/notes/occurrence date correction never replays stage automation. Immutable original account/private author cannot be changed. Document/witness/original assessor replacement is outside ordinary correction fields; no arbitrary field patch or universal Undo. Use explicit new evidence record where necessary, retaining previous private document and provenance under ownership/deletion rules. Invalid historical commitment/lifecycle may be voided/corrected with attributable history and recomputed current projection, preserving earlier assessments. Stale foreign/cross-person or replayed conflicting mutation writes nothing.

Return active same plant exact/potential/no-match hints from normalized email/phone/name; ignore empty/short contact signals and escape SQL wildcards literally. Family name/shared mailbox is only hint, never unique human identity or mandatory merge. Import hints redact to ID/display name. Pair review requires current revisions and disclose conservative blocked merge cause. User may intentionally create duplicate with explicit choice; no foreign retired row or model identity judgment leaks.

Implement REQ-PPL-024 and REQ-PPL-025 as the complete merge/retirement/reference/inverse contract. Preserve field choice preview, account-link survivor protection, private photo choice, source and correction history, exact conflict checks, idempotent receipt and acyclic merged-source redirects. The required Unmerge inverse stays available; raw restore cannot replace it. Historical source callable identity is unavailable in current evidence and no implemented source symbol is claimed. Every later consumer's actual reference integration must pass before that package closes.

Use RFC 4180 parser with BOM/CRLF/commas/escaped quotes/quoted multiline and explicit malformed quoting errors. Keep 12 contact input columns(first_name, last_name, email, phone, street, city, state, postal_code, country, source, source_details, notes); normalizer/defaults match People and background fields are absent. Server limits 10 MiB/10000 rows and reparses validated original bytes/row digest, never trusts client-returned parsed rows. Preview all valid/invalid/existing and within-file duplicate rows; resolutions skip/create/create_and_review never overwrite existing Person. Save frozen reviewed row/resolution digest with import intent; per-row short transactions record created/skipped/error and optional new review pair. Retry resumes only unfinished row keys, no duplicate earlier success. Stale review/authority/digest refuses; partial import returns named row reasons and remaining work, not generic failed after commits.

Export same current filters as directory with 15 documented columns: first_name, last_name, email, phone, street, city, state, postal_code, country, status, source, source_details, notes, tags, created_at; tags semicolon joined and recorded createdAt UTC. Header-only empty export valid. RFC 4180 escaping preserves comma/newline/quotes; spread sheet-dangerous leading=,+,-,@, TAB/CR values get documented leading apostrophe neutralization. The exact bytes are CSV notan XLSXclaim. Private photo/account/storage/qualification/background/care fields are absent. Tenant read/export authority rechecked; large exports stream/bound rows and include exact filter/count receipt. Narrow 12 column import ignores status/tags/date, so never claim lossless backup/roundtrip.

Preserve only conditional source transitions: attended Vision prospect→at ten dee, active ministry membership core_group→launch_team, ordinary ministry leadership launch_team→leader. Interview event advances earlier stage to interviewed, commitment earlier stage to core_group; repeated recording/correction preserves advanced stage. Perform approved progression with original actor/history/source revision in producer transaction; asyncwake-up cannot be the only critical writer. Retry same event no-ops without duplicate history. No automatic demotion on role leave, training revoke, commitment withdrawal or plant launch date/phase change. No process-local noop handler is a durable feature.

Project own ing Teams/Training/Communication data under exact Person/tenant current permission; merge redirects and retired history consistent. Show distinct current membership plus dated former tenure; explicit assigned training obligations separate from earned/revoked/former completion history. Actual email sent/accepted/delivered/opened/clicked/bounced/failed are distinct from typed human contact logs; contact badge must not claim provider mail delivery. Empty/unavailable states explain truth and read-only user has no send control. Dates use church zone intentionally; tabs never widen scope.

The uncalled deferred follow-up-initiation warning and undelivered interview next-step automatic task prompt are not executable target capabilities. Consolidate useful intent into explicit ordinary follow-up create/assign or reviewed task creation, retaining manualfollowing_up stage. No no-op tool, hidden subscriber, automatic qualification or autonomous stage/task side effect is registered. Show recorded next steps as text with option to explicitly open a task draft.

Retain the useful source helper behavior as an internal authenticated same-tenant aggregate query. Count distinct active canonical Persons per current stage at a frozen asOf/revision; separately count distinct Persons with each exact adjacent forward transition within an explicit occurrence-date window, deduplicating repeated forward/backward moves. Preserve the actual historical transition source/revision and name the event window and unit. A conversion rate requires a reconstructable distinct source-stage-at-window cohort; when that denominator cannot be established, return Unknown with the known transition count, never combine current stage population with historical event counts. Do not use these rates as readiness or silently substitute them for named Plant Intelligence metrics. No new visible widget, Evry tool, separate analytics service or actorless helper API is added. The source unmounted status is provenance, not authority to remove the internal useful query.

Publish a static `person_references` manifest in the target schema catalog, not a new runtime registry table. Each Person-bearing consumer registers resource/field, exact tenant FK, current versus historical meaning, source/survivor lock order, retirement treatment, merge rewrite rule, uniqueness/collision refusal, private ownership/authorship restriction, reviewed inverse policy and named fixtures. Every writer locks/validates the active Person within its transaction before adding a reference, so a merge racing an insert cannot leave a new current reference on the retired source. WP-015 closes only then-present People/account/household/qualification consumers. Later team/training, attendance/RSVP/card/kit, follow-up/task/contact, communication, Launch guest, documents and Evry proposal/artifact owners add registrations and real merge/retirement/inverse fixtures before their own closure. Immutable historical actor/event/document snapshots retain original provenance with authorized identity lineage rather than arbitrary rewrite. Private-care account-author references are excluded from Person movement. Final WP-056/057 closure verifies the full manifest against the actual schema and every later producer; early merge is not a whole-target claim.

`people.getMergeReview` returns exact current revisions, all differing stored field choices, account/household/photo/current-lifecycle effects, moved/deduplicated references and named blockers. Lock both live same plant Persons in stable ID order and their consumer subjects; one atomic merge updates survivor/reference projections, retires source, records original snapshots/choices plus typed moved-row IDs/pre-post revisions/inverse constraints in `person_merge`, appends history/audit/receipt and advances source revision. Two account-linked Persons cannot merge; the linked Person must survive, account grants/author identity cannot move, and no arbitrary storage/user ID enters the payload. Conservative collisions include same-meeting attendance/card, active training assignment/completion, pending RSVP, distinct live obligation, referral cycle and conflicting household/leadership state; disclose exact conflicts rather than silently dropping records. Repeated same merge returns original receipt; conflicting destination or stale review refuses; source redirects follow recorded acyclic lineage.

Retain the required Unmerge capability through `people.previewUnmerge`/`people.unmergePeople`, both native and exact-reviewed Evry. The preview names the original merge and full inverse. Execute only when recorded survivor/field/photo/account/reference revisions are unchanged and every manifest inverse/uniqueness/tenant check proves restoration without discarding later facts. Under the same locks/CAS restore source and recorded moved/deduplicated references, restore prior survivor values, append a new reversal receipt/history/audit and advance source revision; retain the original merge receipt. Retrying reversal converges. A source-row-only restore is never Unmerge. A chained merge, new/corrected reference, credential/author conflict, sent-mail/disclosure or other irreversible effect whose attribution cannot be safely reversed causes exact conflict refusal with zero inverse effects. Offer separately reviewed manual correction/split of named records within ordinary domain authority, preserving later history and original authorship; operator recovery is not a substitute for the safe native inverse and never unsends mail. No universal undo promise.

Record explicit adult_classification=adult|child|unknown with dated attributable correction history; DOB is optional and never required. Maintain authoritative per-person/plant commitment lifecycle active|withdrawn|unknown, separate from signature rows and stage. At frozen asOf/source revision, count each live same plant classified adult with currently active supported core-group or launch-team commitment once, regardless of repeated cards, ministry roles or account link. Two eligible household adults count two; role/stage/account alone supplies no evidence. Known children, current withdrawal, retired/merged-away sources and foreign records are excluded with lineage. Unknown classification/state is visible. Exact count is available only with complete evidence; 30 established adults meet≥30 even with a partial cohort, 29 plus a consequential unknown yields Unknown, reliably bounded below 30 may fail while exact count stays unknown; unavailable read is never zero. No blanket classify-every-contact or renewal gate.

Historical genuine acquisition is independent from current size. Use each canonical person's earliest valid actual eligible commitment occurrence, not recorded/corrected/classified/rejoined time. A real withdrawal decreases current size but preserves its genuine acquisition and the latest-first acquisition clock; later genuine reactivation restores current size without a new person or clock reset. Correcting an invalid historical event/date may remove/move that acquisition and recompute current windows/clock with old/new/actor/reason history. The 2026-10-13 15:32 semantic ruling expressly settles this difference. Deduplicate through explicit merge lineage, never similar name/email. Preserve trailing 28 day versus prior 28 day first-acquisition counts: net current headcount and growthDelta do not define the flat clock. 20 days permits neither slowed nor stalled, 21–27 permits slowed only,≥28 permits stalled and fails the established growth-trajectory test. Missing/invalid/future consequential occurrence evidence leaves timing Unknown, independently of known size. All date/window boundaries use frozen church-local LocalDate, with windows [ asOf -27, asOf ] and [ asOf -55, asOf -28]; no UTC-midnight reinterpretation. Old assessments retain their formula/asOf/source lineage.
